title: BJP stages protest in Guwahati demanding apology from Congress chief
seoTitle: Guwahati BJP protest against Congress chief

tea.why: Protesters condemned Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge's alleged remarks about Prime Minister Narendra Modi's late father.
tea.want: Protesters demanded an apology and resignation from Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge.
tea.changed: Oct 26: The Assam BJP unit held a sit-in protest in Guwahati outside the Bhogeswar Baruah Sports Complex.

summary: The Assam unit of the Bharatiya Janata Party staged a protest in Guwahati on October 26, 2026, condemning alleged remarks made by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge regarding Prime Minister Narendra Modi's late father during an event in Patna. BJP workers and leaders gathered for a sit-in outside the Bhogeswar Baruah Sports Complex at Sarusajai, raising slogans against senior Congress leaders and demanding an apology and resignation from Kharge. According to a statement issued by BJP state spokesperson Ranjib Kumar Sharma, more than 1,000 party members participated. Several local leaders, MLAs, and morcha presidents addressed the gathering, criticizing the opposition party's political decorum and warning of an expanded public agitation if an apology is not issued.
demands: A public apology from Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge
The resignation of Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The Assam BJP unit staged a protest in Guwahati at Sarusajai to condemn remarks made by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge.
